name: Found in Alabama — Nifty Sync
description: Captures items from your Nifty.ai inventory — one page or all pages automatically — and links them to Found in Alabama haul posts via the private-notes haul-slug convention. Also sends approved Found in Alabama listing drafts into Nifty as drafts, and checks recent sales and delists (read-only). Pilot: deactivates Mercari listings FIA planned to delist, in your own Mercari tab, when you press Delist.
